notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). The skill covers provisioning Cloud SQL PostgreSQL/MySQL instances with HA and backups, private IP via VPC peering, read replicas, backups/PITR/export-import, the Cloud SQL Auth Proxy, Terraform resources and common operations.

Medium: following it has the agent run billable, state-changing gcloud commands with the user's authenticated GCP credentials (enable APIs, create instances, users, replicas and VPC peering, patch/restart instances, promote replicas, import SQL into an instance) and download the Cloud SQL Auth Proxy binary from storage.googleapis.com (pinned to v2.11.0, no checksum) and execute it. Acceptable because these are reference operations for the user's own project, nothing deletes instances or disables security (Terraform sample sets deletion_protection, require_ssl and private IP only), and passwords are generated randomly rather than hard-coded.

Cautions: `--root-password=$(openssl rand -base64 24)` (SKILL.md:54, 72) generates a password that is never saved, so the user must reset it or capture it; `gcloud sql instances restart`, `promote-replica` and `sql import` into prod-db (SKILL.md:109, 124, 241) disrupt production and should be confirmed with the user. Related skills (gcp-networking, terraform-gcp, gcp-gke, gcp-compute) are named as optional reading only.
